name: cll-equivalence-smoke
description: Fast reference/candidate contract check on exactly one local CLL prepared unit.
limitations: This profile tests computational equivalence and benchmark plumbing; it does not estimate biological accuracy.
Identical reference and candidate snapshots are allowed only so this profile can self-test the harness; that result is not evidence about an optimization.
Eight targets and five trees are deliberately too small for performance conclusions.
Local expression, group, and TF files are supplied through a separately generated ignored manifest and are not stored in the repository.

cases.description: One bounded reference/candidate pair per selected prepared unit.
